summary.text: Robin Webb is a Republican state senator who has represented District 18 since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Robin Webb earned an A.A.S. and a B.S. from Morehead State University in 1983 and a J.D. from Chase College of Law at Northern Kentucky University in 1986.

Her professional experience includes working as a coal miner for Ruth Contracting, as an attorney for the Natural Resources Cabinet Surface Mine Litigation Unit, as a sole practitioner, and as general counsel for AEI Resources, Incorporated.
She served in the Kentucky House of Representatives from 1999 to 2009.
On May 30, 2025, Webb announced a change in her partisan affiliation from Democratic to Republican.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Senate Agriculture, Appropriations and Revenue, Families and Children, and Natural Resources and Energy committees.
